summary: Fixed a race where a waiting folder swallowed the sync turn, leaving the tray icon stuck on syncing forever.
changelog: When the shared sync permit woke a waiting folder that then could not start (for example a leftover waiter with an empty queue), the turn was swallowed and every other waiting folder stayed queued forever with nothing running - the tray icon stayed on cloud-sync. The turn is now passed on to the next waiter (issue #197).
This became visible with the ETag gate making runs milliseconds long; the regression test covers the exact double-waiter interleaving.
